title: Security
descriptionHtml:
Edgemesh filters bots and invalid traffic at the front door to your store before they reach your analytics, ad audiences, or conversion rate. Everything downstream is measured on real shoppers.

  • Bot and invalid traffic filtering
  • Verified crawler acceleration
  • Geographic traffic controls
  • AI assistant guidance

For qualified brands

Security and Signal are free for Shopify and Shopify Plus brands doing $25M or more in annual gross merchandise value.

summary: Protect your storefront and keep automated noise out of your business metrics.

title: Signal
